title: ICAI Invites MCQs for Advanced IT Test Question Bank
content:
# ICAI Invites MCQs for Advanced IT Test Question Bank

Ek important update hai! The Institute of Chartered Accountants of India (ICAI) ne Advanced Integrated Course on Information Technology and Soft Skills (AICITSS) – Advanced IT test ke Question Bank ke liye contributions invite kiye hain.

*   **What's New:** ICAI has issued an invitation for Chartered Accountants and experts to submit Multiple Choice Questions (MCQs) for the Advanced IT test.
*   **Purpose:** These MCQs will contribute to the Question Bank for the mandatory Advanced IT test.
*   **Who is the Test For:** This test is compulsory for CA students who have qualified the Intermediate Examination and completed their 15-day Advanced Information Technology Training.
*   **Test Pattern:** The Advanced IT test comprises 100 MCQs, to be completed in a duration of two hours.
*   **Passing Criteria:** Students need to secure a minimum of 40 marks to qualify the test, and there is no negative marking.
*   **Honorarium:** An honorarium of ₹500 will be paid for each MCQ that gets selected by the Institute's review panel.
*   **Announcement Date:** This invitation was published on October 1, 2026.
